scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev src/api/main.py
scripts.generate:api-client: uv run --directory apps/api python scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --filter @resolve-flow/api-client generate
scripts.check:api-client: uv run --directory apps/api python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && pnpm --filter @resolve-flow/api-client check:generated
scripts.fix: pnpm format && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check --fix .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:api && pnpm typecheck:api-client
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:api-client && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
